name: Networks
description:
These APIs manage network configurations for customer-managed VPCs (optional). Its ID is
used when creating a new workspace if you use customer-managed VPCs.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a Databricks network configuration that represents an VPC and its resources. The VPC will be used for new Databricks clusters. This requires a pre-existing VPC and subnets.

all_fields.name: network_name
all_fields.description: The human-readable name of the network configuration.

all_fields.name: security_group_ids
all_fields.description: IDs of one to five security groups associated with this network. Security group IDs **cannot** be used in multiple network configurations.

all_fields.name: subnet_ids
all_fields.description: IDs of at least two subnets associated with this network. Subnet IDs **cannot** be used in multiple network configurations.

all_fields.name: vpc_id
all_fields.description: The ID of the VPC associated with this network configuration. VPC IDs can be used in multiple networks.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description:
Deletes a Databricks network configuration, which represents a cloud VPC and its resources. You cannot delete a network that is associated with a workspace.

This operation is available only if your account is on the E2 version of the platform.

required_fields.name: network_id
required_fields.description: Databricks Account API network configuration ID.

required_in_url_fields.name: network_id
required_in_url_fields.description: Databricks Account API network configuration ID.

all_fields.name: network_id
all_fields.description: Databricks Account API network configuration ID.

required_positional_arguments.name: network_id
required_positional_arguments.description: Databricks Account API network configuration ID.
